hero.title: Music Story - Website redesign
hero.subtitle: Migrating a legacy WordPress site to a maintainable Next.js platform.
summary: Led the end-to-end migration of the public marketing website to the Next.js App Router with Tailwind CSS and localization.
Introduced reusable components, improved page performance, and set up a robust workflow for future iterations with the internal team.

highlights.title: Performance-driven migration
highlights.description: Audited WordPress pages, re-architected layouts with server components, and delivered repeatable Core Web Vitals improvements.

highlights.title: Content and localization workflow
highlights.description: Structured data and translation files to separate content from presentation, enabling editors to ship localized pages faster.

highlights.title: Motion with accessibility in mind
highlights.description: Applied Framer Motion for subtle interactions while preserving accessible focus management and keyboard navigation.

deliverables: Audit and migration plan covering 20+ public pages
Responsive design system implemented with Tailwind CSS
Automated Lighthouse checks integrated into CI

sections.title: What needed to change
paragraphs: The legacy WordPress stack produced inconsistent performance and depended on plugins that were difficult to maintain.
We defined objectives around loading speed, maintainability, localization, and keeping visual identity consistent.

sections.title: Approach
paragraphs: I rebuilt the site with server components, orchestrated translations with next-intl, and introduced shared UI primitives reviewed alongside the design team.
bullets: Created composable layout blocks (hero, feature grids, CTA stripes).
Documented deployment workflow and monitoring dashboards to guarantee content parity.
Delivered maintenance guidelines backed by Storybook snippets.

sections.title: Outcome
paragraphs: The new site launched on schedule with improved Lighthouse scores, localized content, and a maintainable codebase ready for future landing pages.

hero.title: Paris 92 - Performance dashboard
hero.subtitle: Centralizing match statistics and analytics for the Paris 92 handball staff.
summary: Designed and shipped a secure internal dashboard to gather match data, video analysis and physical metrics for the staff.
Collaborated with the performance coach to define visualizations that answer day-to-day questions during the season.

meta.label: Team
meta.value: Solo delivery with weekly staff feedback

highlights.title: Unified data ingestion
highlights.description: Automated imports from spreadsheets and scouting tools to eliminate manual copy-and-paste workflows.

highlights.title: Actionable dashboards
highlights.description: Crafted charts and filters that let coaches compare players, monitor workloads, and prepare match sheets in minutes.

highlights.title: Secure access
highlights.description: Implemented role-based access and audit logs to respect the confidentiality of medical and performance data.

deliverables: Responsive dashboard UI built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS
PostgreSQL schema for statistics, players, and training sessions
Documentation for staff to upload new datasets autonomously

sections.title: Understanding staff needs
paragraphs: Work sessions with analysts revealed a fragmented workflow across spreadsheets, video tools, and handwritten notes.
We prioritized scenarios that would save coaches time on debriefs and match preparation.

sections.title: Building the platform
paragraphs: I set up a modular API, database migrations, and reusable visual components tailored to the staff vocabulary.
bullets: Created batch jobs to ingest statistics right after matches.
Designed KPI widgets for offensive and defensive trends.
Prepared handover material so staff can adapt indicators every season.

paris92.confidentialNote: Screens and code are confidential; shared metrics remain at a high level.

hero.title: MedChemStructure Genius - Discovery cockpit
hero.subtitle: Connecting structure-activity data, guided reviews, and training drills in a single cockpit.
summary: Leading the ongoing build of a secure workspace that centralizes SAR dossiers, experiment timelines, and retrosynthesis notes for medicinal chemists.
Shaped quiz-style structure challenges, review trails, and notifications so chemistry, data, and clinical leads stay aligned during triage.
Project is still live - always happy to answer questions or walk through the roadmap.

highlights.title: Interactive structure drills
highlights.description: Integrated quiz sessions and spaced-repetition checkpoints that help chemists validate structure knowledge directly from pipeline data.

highlights.title: Cross-team review loops
highlights.description: Designed guided review flows that capture decisions, annotations, and approvals, reducing coordination friction across squads.

highlights.title: Data lineage overlays
highlights.description: Surfaced experiment lineage, assay outcomes, and notebook references within the cockpit so teams can audit every recommendation.

deliverables: Design system powered by TailwindCSS with labs-friendly theming and motion patterns
PostgreSQL schema combining compounds, assays, review threads, and quiz sessions
Expo mobile companion for quick structure drills and push reminders during lab shifts

results.label: Current focus
results.value: Pilot rollout and knowledge base curation

results.label: Pilot teams
results.value: Discovery squads in two therapeutic programs

sections.title: Understanding the challenge
paragraphs: Chemists previously juggled spreadsheets, ELN exports, and static slide decks whenever a candidate was reviewed.
We mapped their decision checkpoints and highlighted where automation could replace manual collation and status tracking.

sections.title: What we built
paragraphs: I orchestrated a modular Next.js architecture with server components for data-heavy sections and APIs that run structure scoring jobs.
Together with the designer we prototyped dashboard layouts, quiz flows, and notifications reused across the web cockpit and Expo app.
bullets: Streaming molecular metrics with incremental static regeneration to keep dossiers fast to open.
Contextual notifications that stay in sync between web and mobile through a shared push service.
Fine-grained access controls so project leads can invite external reviewers securely.

medchemStructureGenius.confidentialNote: Screens anonymized and molecular data replaced with placeholders for confidentiality.
